name: ProductBurst

sources.title: ProductBurst homepage — Bubble-built SPA, only shell rendered to fetcher
AllDirectories profile — free submission, multi-step form details
Firsto profile — free, no backlink required, account not required per this source
LaunchDirectories guide — free submission, dofollow, daily featured format

requirements: Early-stage SaaS / indie product with a live website link
Third-party sources agree submission is free with dofollow links and no badge requirement
Account creation appears to be required (AllDirectories reports a login wall); one source claims otherwise — conflicting
preparation: Product description (rich-text editor, max ~2000 characters per AllDirectories)
Category selections (multi-select), logo and optional screenshots
workflow: Open https://productburst.com/ (or /pre-launch) — the site is a Bubble SPA; JS required
Complete the multi-step form (Details / Extras / Payment tabs reported; payment tab likely optional upsell)
Submit and wait for review — third-party reports approval within a few days
Product is featured in the daily selection once approved
watchFor: Site is a Bubble app — pages return almost no HTML to plain fetchers; use a real browser
A 'Payment' tab exists in the multi-step form — do not click submit/pay without confirming it is optional
Sources conflict on whether an account is required
countsAsLive: Product has a page under productburst.com/product/<slug> and appears in the daily featured rotation
unknowns: First-party submission terms — the SPA did not render form content to a text fetcher
Whether the Payment tab is a required step or an optional boost
